claims.text: Empire New Mexico includes approximately 709 gross (525 net) wells on 48,000 gross (41,000 net) acres in Lea County, New Mexico.

citation.quote: Empire New Mexico includes approximately 709 gross (525 net) wells on 48,000 gross (41,000 net) acres in Lea County, New Mexico.

claims.text: Oil is the primary product from Empire New Mexico’s assets, which also produce natural gas and NGLs.

citation.quote: Empire New Mexico’s assets primarily produce oil with accompanying natural gas and NGLs production.

claims.text: The company says its geographic concentration exposes it to regional supply and demand factors, processing or transportation capacity constraints, severe weather events, water shortages, and government regulations.

citation.quote: Because of the concentration, the Company is exposed to the impact of regional supply and demand factors, processing or transportation capacity constraints, severe weather events, water shortages, and government regulations specific to the geographic area.

claims.text: NMOCD regulates New Mexico oil and gas activity and gathers well production data.

citation.quote: The New Mexico Oil Conservation Division regulates oil and gas activity in New Mexico. The Division gathers well production data, permits new wells, enforces the division’s rules and the state’s oil and gas statutes
